scope: Model/editor Product Quality v2 naturalness polish of EN-A1-L-0077; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Character prompts and English distractors were re-read as complete learner-facing utterances; teacher directives and known ungrammatical generated distractors were removed.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps thing to the bounded situation sense used in this lesson.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical target is practiced inside familiar short sentence frames.

distractorQuality.evidence: Wrong English options are grammatical/natural alternatives that differ on meaning, action, referent, quantity, polarity or context instead of using broken substitutions.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Character turns now ask or react in ways that pragmatically license the learner response rather than instructing the learner to repeat a line.

difficultyFit.evidence: The lesson stays at short early-A1 utterance length and adds one bounded lexical target.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: thing is repeated through recognition, guided response, transfer and hidden retrieval rather than copied in one identical task.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response changes the communicative decision while keeping the bounded target sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities and outcome align on the same target.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; engagement and perceived difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
